event.description: tie nearest aligned operand position pair
event.proposal: Representational positional integration: incumbent positions 4 and 15 are aligned A/B digit columns and their learned vectors differ by only 0.0026 in L2 norm, the closest distinct pair; make just those positions share their averaged row while leaving the other 30 rows independent, saving 16 parameters and isolating one-column tying from the earlier failed all-column tie.
